display_long_description:
# **Bring dinosaurs back to life in your own space. 🦖**
Assemble giant skeletons **bone by bone** in a hands-on mixed-reality puzzle featuring **dinosaurs and other prehistoric creatures.**

Begin with **5 iconic species** and grow your lab with new discoveries.
>
# 🦴 Turn your room into a dinosaur lab.
[media]
Rebuild prehistoric giants **bone by bone** in mixed reality.

>

# 📏 Life-Size Dinosaur Reveal
[media]
Once completed, watch them appear at **full, life-size scale** in your own environment.
>

# 💡Multiple Difficulty Levels

[media]

Each species includes **three levels of complexity**, letting you choose between a more accessible puzzle or a deeper reconstruction challenge.

>

# 🧠 Learn as You Build

[media]

As each bone finds its place, **scientific insights appear**, revealing how dinosaur skeletons were structured and discovered.
>

# 🦕 Start with 5 Species
Start with **5 iconic prehistoric giants** including **Tyrannosaurus Rex and Pteranodon.**

New creature packs will expand the lab with **more species and discoveries.**
>

# 💬 Join our Discord 
Follow upcoming dinosaurs, share feedback, and connect with other players.

**👉 discord.gg/PW2Qwavp4d**
